timeline.summary: Bolas reveals Tezzeret's sanctum; the attack on the Iron Tower fails and Jace is captured.
timeline.quote: The attack on the Iron Tower failed, however, and Jace was captured.

citation.text: "Fall of the Infinite Consortium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana frees Jace and Jace lures Tezzeret to Kamigawa, where he dismembers him, tearing off his etherium arm.
timeline.quote: dueled and dismembered Tezzeret, tearing off his etherium arm and crippling his mind

citation.text: "Fall of the Infinite Consortium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas deems Liliana's failure a breach and offers service for freedom, which she rejects; he takes Tezzeret's broken body to rebuild.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret’s broken body, which he began rebuilding for his designs

citation.text: "Fall of the Infinite Consortium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls that she and Jace once worked for Tezzeret's Consortium (backstory).
timeline.quote: when she and Jace had worked for Tezzeret's criminal Consortium

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: A gray-haired hooded man sneaks through Ghirapur toward the Inventors' Fair, avoiding patrols.
timeline.quote: A gray-haired man slipped through Ghirapur with a series of sideways moves.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The hooded man hides his face and arm in the crowd to complete his mission unnoticed.
timeline.quote: He needed to complete his mission before anyone had a chance to notice him.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The hooded man shows a Leaking Spire symbol to renegade inventors and steals a listener module from an automaton.
timeline.quote: The little metallic listener module obeyed his commands, prying itself out of her device.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The module reveals to the man the conversations and a location for the demonstration.
timeline.quote: As he walked, he willed it to activate

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra calls to the hooded man, who runs away through the crowd.
timeline.quote: he dashed away from them, through a bank of onlookers and around a Consulate checkpoint.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The man accosts an older woman, pointing a metallic claw hand at her.
timeline.quote: His right hand, emerging from his sleeve, was a metallic claw

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls the woman Renegade Prime and warns her spectacle will not matter to his Fair, but she vows to stop the Head Judge.
timeline.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana grabs the man and names him Tezzeret with disgust.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret, flanked by automatons and Dovin Baan, seizes Pia with his metal claw.
timeline.quote: The hand that gripped her arm was a massive claw of dark metal

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret calls Pia the Renegade Prime and she vows to stop him.
timeline.quote: I've found you at last, Renegade Prime

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana appears and names Tezzeret, and he names her Vess in return.
timeline.quote: A pale woman clad in dark flowing silks and a glinting golden headpiece appeared opposite the Head Judge.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: To protect Chandra, Pia announces herself as the renegade leader and surrenders to Consulate custody.
timeline.quote: My name is Pia Nalaar, leader of the renegades. I'm prepared to enter Consulate custody.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls Jace's scars when she thinks of Tezzeret and warns he is dangerous.
timeline.quote: Jace, his back stitched with ugly white scars from a manablade.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret greets the infamous Pia Nalaar after her capture.
timeline.quote: At last, the infamous Pia Nalaar.

citation.text: Captured by the Consulate (Kaladesh, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A Grand Exhibition showdown pits Tezzeret against Pia Nalaar.
timeline.quote: witness Head Judge Tezzeret face off against the infamous renegade Pia Nalaar

citation.text: Fateful Showdown (Kaladesh, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Under Tezzeret's order, citizens are told to surrender their inventions.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions.

citation.text: Confiscation Coup (Kaladesh, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Inventors' Fair, Tezzeret steals Rashmi's matter transporter to make a Planar Bridge, and Pia and Chandra Nalaar are arrested.
timeline.quote: The theft of Rashmi's prize-winning matter transporter by Tezzeret , who secretly repurposed it into a Planar Bridge

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Inventors' Fair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani Goldmane and the Gatewatch free prisoners and confront Tezzeret during the final dueling showcase, igniting open conflict.
timeline.quote: who freed prisoners and confronted Tezzeret during the final dueling showcase, ignited open conflict.

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Inventors' Fair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Kaladesh, Chandra recognizes the rogue artificer Renegade Prime as her mother Pia.
timeline.quote: Chandra recognized Renegade Prime as her presumed dead mother, Pia

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Return to Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra and her mother are reunited after the confrontation with the Head Judge.
timeline.quote: Chandra and her mother are finally reunited.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Return to Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baral helps Tezzeret steal inventions and abduct inventors from the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: Baral later helped Tezzeret steal the best inventions

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret orders Baral to distract Chandra, with Dovin Baan supervising; Baral lures Chandra away until Nissa blocks him and Baan picks him up.
timeline.quote: Baral began to taunt Chandra, luring her away from her companions

citation.text: "Dhiren Baral", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrests Renegade Prime (Pia Nalaar), and Baan orders gearhulks to isolate Chandra, but Pia surrenders.
timeline.quote: Renegade Prime, however, relented and let herself be taken into custody.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During Tezzeret's coup Baan hesitantly cooperates and is promised leadership of the institution manufacturing the streamlined inventions, in exchange for dealing with the Gatewatch.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret demanded that Dovin Baan take care of the Gatewatch since it was due to his invitation that they were here.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Baan advises encircling the Aether Hub, identifies Chandra as the Gatewatch's weakest link, and Tezzeret orders Baral to distract her.
timeline.quote: Baan stated that the weakest link of the group was Chandra Nalaar, due to her impulsiveness.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch confronts Tezzeret at the arena; he ends the Inventor's Fair and retreats, having used them as a distraction.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret announced the end of the Inventor's Fair and retreated to a skyship

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Kaladesh, Gideon clashes with Chandra and Liliana over how the Gatewatch should treat the Consulate.
timeline.quote: Gideon reminded her that the purpose of the Gatewatch was not traveling from plane to plane to impose their judgment

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dovin and Nissa travel to Kaladesh, gather Consulate reinforcements and find Tezzeret confronting Pia, Liliana and Chandra.
timeline.quote: Dovin and Nissa travel to Kaladesh, where Dovin gets Consulate reinforcements

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Crackdown on renegades". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret duels Pia and sends an attack clearly meant to kill her.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret sent an attack at Pia that was clearly intended to kill her.

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Quicksmithing duel between Tezzeret and Renegade Prime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra drops her disguise and saves Pia, and the Gatewatch joins the fight against Tezzeret and his guards.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch all joined the fighting

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Quicksmithing duel between Tezzeret and Renegade Prime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Consulate enforcers seize all the inventions submitted for judging 'for safekeeping' while the crowd flees.
timeline.quote: seized all the wondrous prizes submitted for judging

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "The Consulate's confiscation of inventions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret withdraws to a secretive laboratory in the Aether Spire with Rashmi's device to develop a Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret withdrew to a secretive laboratory in the Aether Spire

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "The Consulate's confiscation of inventions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch is unexpectedly confronted by the scheming Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch unexpectedly is confronted by the scheming Tezzeret .

citation.text: "Kaladesh", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liliana overwhelms Tezzeret atop the Aether Spire.
timeline.quote: Liliana managed to overwhelm him

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oviya meets Ajani Goldmane, who came to Kaladesh to track Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: Oviya made the acquaintance of Ajani Goldmane

citation.text: "Oviya Pashiri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret located Pia, Chandra appeared, and Dovin Baan sent gearhulks, so Pia turned herself in again.
timeline.quote: Pia willingly turned herself in again.

citation.text: "Pia Nalaar", section "Renegade Prime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret staged a quicksmithing duel with Pia as bait for Chandra while he stole the inventions.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret set up a quicksmithing duel between himself and Pia

citation.text: "Pia Nalaar", section "Renegade Prime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Kaladesh Tezzeret becomes Head Judge and identifies Pia Nalaar as the Renegade Prime.
timeline.quote: He identified Pia Nalaar as the Renegade Prime of Ghirapur

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret nearly kills Pia but Chandra attacks and the Gatewatch appears; he retreats into the Skysovereign.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret nearly killed Pia, but was attacked by Chandra Nalaar before he could

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Nashi overhears Tamiyo tell Ajani that Nashi's village was burned by planeswalkers at the behest of the criminal Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: It was at the behest of a planeswalking criminal named Tezzeret.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo says Tezzeret died three years ago, killed by Nashi's villagers and betrayed by comrades.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret died...three years ago, I think?

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: In a flashback five months ago Ajani tells Nashi he is leaving Kamigawa to find the man who killed Nashi's family.
timeline.quote: To find the man who killed your family.

citation.text: "Release" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Nissa he has followed Tezzeret's movements on Kaladesh for weeks.
timeline.quote: We've been following Tezzeret's movements here for weeks.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Banners across the city advertise a showdown between Head Judge Tezzeret and the renegade criminal Pia Nalaar the next noon.
timeline.quote: INVENTORS! COME WITNESS THE SHOWDOWN OF THE CENTURY.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The duel starts with Pia and Tezzeret each given a container of basic parts.
timeline.quote: Let the showdown...begin!

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia's booby-trapped servo destroys the legs of Tezzeret's crawler.
timeline.quote: The servo burst in a small sphere of smoke and pieces, and blew the legs off the crawler.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret's devices devour her parts, kill her thopter and he summons an army of automatons around her.
timeline.quote: Bands of metal curved unnaturally at his will, coiling in on themselves to become a small squad of other sharp-legged automatons.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret declares he will mete out justice and sets his automaton to kill Pia.
timeline.quote: I will mete out proper justice for yours.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: A bolt of fire from the audience fells the attacking automaton; Chandra has intervened.
timeline.quote: The bolt of fire had streaked out of the audience

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra leaps into the arena, refusing her mother's order to leave and declaring she will not lose her again.
timeline.quote: And I'm not losing you again!

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Illusions behind Chandra dissolve to reveal the Gatewatch, and Tezzeret takes a small step backward.
timeline.quote: A host of illusions dissolved behind Chandra, and one by one, a team of Planeswalkers emerged.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers battle Tezzeret's automatons while Ajani and Gideon protect Pia.
timeline.quote: Fire flew, slamming like fists into Tezzeret's machines, felling one after another.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace warns that Tezzeret's blocked mind means he was prepared and they have made a mistake.
timeline.quote: if he knew to block his mind, it means he was prepared for this.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra compresses a blinding point of fire to kill Tezzeret as Liliana urges her on.
timeline.quote: Chandra's fist closed, compressing fire into a tiny point of blinding, seething heat.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The Skysovereign eclipses the arena with its turret ready to fire.
timeline.quote: A stark shadow passed over the arena

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret announces the end of the Inventors' Fair and rises into the airship, retreating.
timeline.quote: And this concludes the Inventors' Fair, everyone.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia says Tezzeret's duel was a distraction and Ajani says he is building something.
timeline.quote: He's building something

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan touches Tezzeret's arm and realizes the metal claw is a replacement limb he had not noticed before.
timeline.quote: he realized it was part of the arm

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says the Gatewatch interrupted his duel and disappeared with the renegade.
timeline.quote: I was referring specifically to the gang of six Planeswalkers who interrupted that duel and disappeared with the renegade.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret claims the confiscations are safeguarding the inventions from renegade attack.
timeline.quote: It's not as though we're stealing their inventions. We're safeguarding them.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret snarls that there is no time, then sheds his rage, which Baan notices.
timeline.quote: There's no time

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret offers Baan the job of leading Consulate exploration of the confiscated inventions.
timeline.quote: And who better than you to lead that effort?

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan explains he invited some Gatewatch planeswalkers as a safeguard, but they refused and only Nissa came.
timeline.quote: I invited some of them here as a safeguard against a potential fault I identified in the plans for the Inventors' Fair

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret orders Baan to fix the situation, secure an inquirium for himself and keep the Bastion on alert.
timeline.quote: You need to fix this, Baan.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals that Rashmi's work has staggering implications larger than Kaladesh and will be his focus.
timeline.quote: Rashmi's work for the fair had staggering implications.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Head Judge Tezzeret calls for theoretical breakthroughs in the Aether Science category.
timeline.quote: Head Judge Tezzeret himself has put out the call for any and all theoretical breakthroughs

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The cloaked figure is revealed as Tezzeret, who was stalking Pia Nalaar; Chandra and Pia, each thinking the other dead, are shocked, and the Consulate takes Pia prisoner.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret, Dovin, and Consulate enforcers take Pia prisoner, accusing her of leading the renegade threat.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: At the Grand Exhibition Chandra runs into the arena and the Gatewatch support her against Tezzeret, who slips away; Pia is safe.
timeline.quote: Just when they think they have Tezzeret cornered, he slips away.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch realize the showdown was Tezzeret's scheme: the Consulate confiscated all the Fair's inventions and Tezzeret locks himself away to build a device.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret's accomplices in the Consulate confiscated all the wondrous inventions at the Fair.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gideon weighs, over coffee, whether the Gatewatch should be taking sides in Kaladesh's local conflict.
timeline.quote: should the Gatewatch be taking sides in this local conflict ?

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra agrees to focus on stopping Tezzeret, while also helping her mother as Pia Nalaar's daughter.
timeline.quote: And, as much as I hate it, I'll try to focus on stopping Tezzeret....for now.

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana says there is just one person she wants to kill on this plane and tells Gideon Tezzeret destroyed something that was hers.
timeline.quote: "He hurt something important to me. Destroyed something that was mine."

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli reveals she has found where Tezzeret is hiding, in a private workshop in the central Aether Spire, where he holds the winning inventor.
timeline.quote: He has locked himself away in a private workshop, hidden in the central Aether Spire.

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi notices that aerowright Sana's workstation was emptied after Tezzeret's first progress check.
timeline.quote: The sight of aerowright Sana's empty workstation dissolved any spirit of comradery

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret arrives for a progress check and bends Bhavin's automaton's arm, then throws Bhavin out and takes his invention.
timeline.quote: "You've failed. Get out."

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells the inventors that anything made in the Inquirium belongs to the Consulate.
timeline.quote: "Anything made in this Inquirium belongs to the Consulate."

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi presents the scaled-up transporter and works out the answer to Tezzeret's nonlinear-transport question.
timeline.quote: If I insert an attenuator into the aether-loop

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret has a functionary dismissed for objecting to rerouting aether and threatens to terminate Rashmi if she cannot move Bhavin's automaton by the next check.
timeline.quote: "If you don't, you will be terminated."

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi tells Tezzeret of the phantom dimensions; he laughs at her, declares the transporter his, and dismisses her.
timeline.quote: "This beautiful creation is now mine. And thus I am done with you."

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret threatens to kill Rashmi and then bring Mitul to complete the transporter and kill him too, and sends functionaries to fetch Mitul.
timeline.quote: I will bring your little friend—Mitul, I believe was his name—to complete the transporter

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi secretly sends a warning note to Mitul through the old transporter ring while distracting Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: dropping the ball of paper through the ring. It disappeared.

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi rigs the transporter so the demonstration backfires; Tezzeret's test sends the automaton onto a box, crushing the desk and shattering the window.
timeline.quote: Too big to fit, Bhavin's masterpiece crushed the box

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi leaps out of the window on a harness cable and escapes Tezzeret above Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: she sprinted to the gaping hole and leapt out into the swirling aether beyond.

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Consul Kambal demands Sram carry out Tezzeret's order to divert the city's aether to the Spire; Sram demands it in writing.
timeline.quote: "You have your orders, Senior Edificer," said Kambal.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Liliana convinces a reluctant Gideon that she must go alone and unarmed to duel and distract Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: I have to go alone, unarmed, or else your whole plan falls apart.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon wonders how the consuls can be blind to Tezzeret's manipulations.
timeline.quote: how can the consuls be so blind to Tezzeret's manipulations?

citation.text: Deft Dismissal (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells the renegades the machine is in motion and their effort is too late.
timeline.quote: Too little, too late. The machine is in motion.

citation.text: Metallic Rebuke (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells his foes the matter is bigger than them.
timeline.quote: This is bigger than you. All of you.

citation.text: Battle at the Bridge (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret completes the Planar Bridge, declaring the real work can begin.
timeline.quote: It is finished. Now the real work can begin.

citation.text: Planar Bridge (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells his foes they cannot comprehend the plans in motion.

citation.text: "Phyrexia: All Will Be One | A Man of Parts" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2023.

citation.text: "Tamiyo", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 2: Bring the End, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2024.

timeline.quote: Jace detected a slumbering, childlike mind deep within the vault, but could not get in.

citation.text: "Loot", section "Maag Taranau". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret grafts the Planar Bridge into himself.

citation.text: One with the Machine (Aetherdrift Commander, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sami announces over the intercom that the Metalman has arrived and prefers the name Tezzeret.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret enters the Seriema from his black engineless ship.
timeline.quote: He pushes into the Seriema with the calm of a prybar.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret questions Haliya about her armor.
timeline.quote: "You wear a wealth of metal," he says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret is delighted that Alpharael fled his creed to live.
timeline.quote: I wanted to live a little longer.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret studies Tannuk, remarking on Llanowar and the power he is afraid of.
timeline.quote: So far from Llanowar … such power in the form.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret greets Sami as the protector of strays and asks for his prize.
timeline.quote: Sami, the generous. Sami, the charitable. Sami, the protector of strays.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells Tezzeret the stone changes the past, as with the vanished miners of Sigma.
timeline.quote: Change the past to suit its purposes.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret laughs at Haliya's objection to counterfeit memories.
timeline.quote: Listen to her! Counterfeit memories, an atrocity.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says he will see the stone now.
timeline.quote: You're keeping it in your hold. I'll see it now.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she cannot let Tezzeret take the object.
timeline.quote: "I can't let you take the object," Haliya says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says he arranged events so the stone would choose him as its conduit.
timeline.quote: I have arranged all this so it will choose me as its conduit.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.quote: It's what your people call it. Isn't it, boy? The stone from the end.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.quote: I won't flee to a better world. I'll stand and face whoever would rule me.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret says the Endstone was made and buried and he will follow it to its maker.
timeline.quote: I must know who made it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret explains he has made himself the shortest path to ground for the Endstone, like lightning.
timeline.quote: I have made myself the shortest path for the Endstone to reach its maker.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret silently forces Haliya's armor to close on her.
timeline.quote: her armor ripples like porridge and closes on her.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret releases Haliya, who drifts limp, and moves to consult the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Haliya drifts away spinning, limbs limp.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.quote: He pinches it between two of his claw-fingers, lifts it above the map, and lets go.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.quote: Uthros. The stone wants to go to Uthros.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: An Illvoi ship arrives beside the Seriema.
timeline.quote: A ship appears beside them.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mm'menon introduces themself and asks to come aboard.
timeline.quote: I am Mm'menon. May I come aboard your home?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.quote: We will take the Endstone there, and I will sell it to its maker in exchange for a glimpse of their power.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.quote: I will not be changed by any hand except my own.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret assigns Mm'menon to provide stealthy speed.
timeline.quote: Your role, Mm'menon, is to provide us with stealthy speed.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.
